guides.name: Contracts
guides.summary: thumb|303x303px|A view of the contracts and buffs Contracts are obtained from either the NPC Legendary Assassin (not to be confused with the unit Legendary Assassin ), or also from the main menu. They make you kill a boss from a random map. Higher tier Contracts are more difficult, with the higher ones often having resistances. Typically, when you do a contract, it gives a very strong damage type buff and a less strong (but still good) secondary damage type buff. Rewards thumb|148x148px|A view of the assassin banner You can get two rewards from completing contracts, those being Assassin tokens and Death dice. Assassin tokens allow you to spin on the Assassin banner, from which you can get one of three units: Legendary Assassin , Somber , or Killstreak . Death Dice allow you to create a secret portal if you have four of them, from which you can get the unit Switchblade if you successfully complete the portal. The higher tier portals have a higher chance of giving a death dice. For the highest chance, you should attempt your highest tier contract every day in order to maximize rewards and take less time to get the secret unit, Switchblade . Reset Depending on the tier of a contract, it will reset after a certain amount of time, also known as a new contract. Typically, the lower tier contracts reset faster, in usually 5-10 minutes, while the higher tier ones take anywhere from 30 minutes to 2 hours. The highest one, at the very right of the contract menu, takes 12 hours to reset, otherwise it would be easy to get the secret. You may get a worse base stat or a better base stat. Requirements To reroll a unit's base stat, you need at least one or which can be obtained from Evolving units, the Battlepass, [https://animeadventures.fandom.com/wiki/Challenges Daily Challenges] and Infinity Mansion Rewards. Rerolling and Worthiness Talk to the Cosmic Cat NPC (found at the Traits and Evolve area) and select "Reroll Potential". A menu will appear which will allow you to select any of your units and displays their current stats and Worthiness. (Do note that the selected unit will be automatically unequipped if previously equipped.) Worthiness is calculated based on takedowns on a unit, every 100 takedowns adds 1% Worthiness, so a unit must have 10,000 takedowns to get 100% Worthiness. It's always recommended to bring a unit's Worthiness to atleast 100% before rerolling any or all stats for a unit because you will have a higher chance to receive a good stat/stats such as a S. Worthiness can go up to 400% however each reroll uses a maximum of 100% s will reroll ALL of a units stats, while as s will only reroll the selected stat. Evolution When Evolving a unit, the stats of the unit will ALWAYS* be better than what it had when unevolved. So it is recommended to always reroll the Stats of your unit with high (preferably 100%) worthiness before evolving them.
